title: Mt. Inasa & Nagasaki Ropeway | See & Do | DISCOVER NAGASAKI/The Official Visitors' Guide

facts.fact: MountInasa rises333m and its summit observatory provides a panoramic view of the city, coastline and port; distant visibility depends on clear weather.
The ropeway approaches the summit from Fuchi Shrine in Fuchimachi.
facts.excerpt: a ropeway operating from Fuchi Shrine
